checkpoint_dir: Directory for saving experiment outputs or checkpoints
detector: Method for landmark extraction from heatmaps
g_alpha: Alpha parameter for Gaussian heatmap spread
loss_params: Loss parameters (accepts a dictionary in JSON)
master_df: Filename of the master dataframe CSV
mdir: Directory to move raw images after processing
num_fts: Number of feature channels for the backbone
num_workers: Number of worker threads for data loading
radius_num: Number of radius values to evaluate
reduction: Method to reduce loss values (e.g., mean, sum)
split: Training strategy for data splitting. If not given, will use whatever master df has as set column.
test_ds: List of data sources reserved for testing
test_patients: List of patient IDs reserved for testing
torch_seed: Random seed for PyTorch and NumPy operations
train_val_ds: List of data sources for training/validation
use_model: Model checkpoint to use for testing (best or last)
wandbpro: Weights & Biases project name for logging
test_loaders: Test the data loaders for consistency
